item.title: Zotero Model Context Protocol Connects Research Library to Claude, ChatGPT and More
item.description:
Zotero Model Context Protocol Connects Research Library to Claude, ChatGPT and More

Zotero has released the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, allowing its research library to be accessed directly from AI assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT.

🔍 Overview

  • Connects Zotero library with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants via the Model Context Protocol.
  • Enables searching, reading, citing, and annotating papers from within the AI chat.
  • Supports semantic search using local, OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama embeddings.

🧩 How it works

  • A single package, zotero-mcp-server, provides three components: MCP server, CLI + agent skill, and Zotero Agent.
  • MCP server communicates with chat apps that speak MCP but have no shell (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cherry Studio, Chorus).
  • CLI + agent skill is for agents with a shell (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode).
  • Zotero Agent enables chatting inside Zotero next to the PDF you are reading.
Component Supported Apps
MCP server Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, Cherry Studio, Chorus
CLI + agent skill Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode
Zotero Agent Chat inside Zotero (next to PDF)

⚙️ Key details

  • Search by title, author, tag, collection, full text, or meaning (semantic search).
  • Read metadata, BibTeX, full text, page ranges, and page images where text extraction garbles math, figures, and tables.
  • Annotate highlights, area boxes, notes, and extract PDF annotations.
  • Write: add papers by DOI, URL, ISBN, BibTeX, or file; manage collections and tags; merge duplicates.
  • In local mode reads come straight from zotero.sqlite; writes go to the running Zotero 10+ or through the web API.
  • Optional Scite citation tallies and retraction alerts.
  • CLI + agent skill keeps 98 tokens in context until needed, instead of ~8k.
  • Zotero Agent knows the item, page and selection you have open; answers link to pages.

🚀 Availability

  • Requires Python 3.10+.
  • Install with uv tool install zotero-mcp-server or pip install zotero-mcp-server.
  • Setup commands: zotero-mcp setup (auto‑configures Claude Desktop), zotero-mcp install-skill for the CLI + agent skill, and install the .xpi in Zotero after adding the zotero-cli plugin for Zotero Agent.
  • To enable Zotero’s local API in Zotero 7+, open Settings → Advanced and tick Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero.
  • One package ships all three components.

💡 Why it matters

  • Provides direct access to a personal research library from AI chat interfaces.
  • Enables semantic search and citation management without leaving the conversation.
  • Handles PDF annotations, math, figures, and tables more accurately.
  • Reduces context size for agents, keeping only 98 tokens until needed.

#Zotero #AIIntegration #ModelContextProtocol

Source: 54yyyu/zotero-mcp

item.title: AnythingMCP Launched as an Open-Source Gateway for AI Model Connectivity
item.description:
AnythingMCP Launched as an Open-Source Gateway for AI Model Connectivity

AnythingMCP is a newly released open-source, self-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway designed to connect AI clients like Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini to enterprise software and internal documents without the need for developers to write custom MCP servers.

🧩 Core Architecture and Features

AnythingMCP functions as a central layer that stores enterprise data in a unified “knowledge graph of how your systems connect,” alongside AI skills and company memory. This data is shared across all connected AI clients while respecting individual user roles.

Key Technical Capabilities

  • Extensive Connectivity: Offers 957 ready connectors supporting over 12,000 tools, including integrations with SAP, Odoo, weclapp, and Amazon Seller. 51 of these connectors operate without an API key.
  • Custom Protocol Support: Provides 696 catalog connectors or supports custom REST, OpenAPI, SOAP, GraphQL, OData, SQL, IMAP, SMTP, and MCP sources. Tools register at runtime.
  • Document Indexing: Indexes SFTP, FTP/FTPS, WebDAV (Nextcloud, NAS), S3, and network shares. It extracts data from PDF pages, Excel rows (including column names), Word documents, PowerPoint files, and Outlook emails with attachments.
  • Traceability: AI answers are returned with specific file, page, and date references for verification.
  • File Management: Generates temporary download links for user files and AI-generated files (such as CSV exports or reports), supporting both internal and public access with expiration and revocation capabilities.
  • Cross-Client Memory: Facts and preferences saved in one AI client are accessible in others (e.g., data entered in Claude is usable by Copilot). Memory is managed with personal and company scopes, organized by folders and role limits.
  • Agent Procedures: Supports procedures that AI agents follow, which can be written manually or learned from actual requests.

⚙️ Usage Example

The gateway enables complex queries spanning multiple systems, such as asking a single question in Claude that is answered using data from Etsy, SAP, and a logistics API simultaneously.

🚀 Availability and Usage

  • Cloud Presence: AnythingMCP Cloud hosts over 16,000 workspaces and processes more than 1.5 million AI tool calls per month.
  • Listing Status: The service is listed in the official Claude directory and the ChatGPT Plugin Directory.
  • Trial Access: A free 7-day trial of the Cloud service is available.

#MCP #AIIntegration #EnterpriseAI #OpenSource #Claude #ChatGPT

Source: HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp

item.title: Salesforce launches AIforce to enable AI‑driven CRM experiences
item.description:
Salesforce launches AIforce to enable AI‑driven CRM experiences

Salesforce announced AIforce at Dreamforce on September 15, 2026. AIforce is a live interface layer that brings Salesforce data, workflows, business logic, semantics, permissions, security, and governance to any AI interface, letting CRM follow users wherever they work.

🔍 Overview

  • More than a chatbot‑style add‑on, AIforce exposes CRM context and governed actions through connected AI experiences.
  • Access remains tied to existing permissions and governance rather than becoming an unrestricted data bridge.

🧩 How It Works

  • Live interface layer: Bridges Salesforce’s core capabilities to any AI workspace.
  • Initial AI experiences:
    Experience Purpose
    Claudeforce AI interaction using Claude models
    Slackforce AI‑enhanced collaboration inside Slack
    Agentforce Coworker AI‑assisted agent console
  • Headless Toolkit: Provides MCPs, APIs, plug‑ins, skills, and developer tools so developers can connect Salesforce with agents, applications, and custom interfaces.
  • Practical use: A sales rep can pull customer information from an approved AI workspace; a support agent can invoke Salesforce workflows while preparing or updating records.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Flexibility: Enables building CRM experiences around a team’s workflow instead of forcing every user onto a single UI.
  • Security & Governance: Permissions, audit trails, data‑handling policies, and escalation paths stay consistent across all AI interfaces.
  • Developer responsibilities:
    • Define which objects an agent can access.
    • Specify allowed actions and error handling.
    • Determine when human approval is required.
  • Modular architecture: Positions CRM as a set of capabilities reachable through multiple interfaces, not a fixed screen.

🚀 Availability & Licensing

  • Salesforce has not published a universal price or full availability matrix.
  • Licensing requirements, regional access, and rollout status must be confirmed for each organization.
  • Adoption will require administration and integration work.

🛠️ Implementation Guidance

  • Start narrow: Choose a measurable workflow such as retrieving account summaries, preparing follow‑up tasks, routing service requests, or drafting updates for review.
  • Test security and governance alongside convenience; verify that permissions apply consistently across custom apps and third‑party workspaces.
  • Map permissions, test business logic, monitor agent behavior, and validate actions before moving to production.
  • Consultation services can help define integration boundaries and set implementation priorities.

💡 Why It Matters

  • AIforce lets companies assemble tailored employee portals, customer‑support tools, mobile apps, or internal automation that leverage Salesforce data without requiring users to learn the standard UI.
  • The approach signals a shift toward modular, interface‑independent CRM systems, but the benefit depends on accurate reflection of underlying records and rules.

item.title: PipesHub Launches Open‑Source Platform for Secure Enterprise Knowledge‑AI Integration
item.description:
PipesHub Launches Open‑Source Platform for Secure Enterprise Knowledge‑AI Integration

PipesHub, an open‑source platform, enables secure connection of enterprise knowledge to AI applications.

🔍 Overview

  • PipesHub is an open‑source platform for securely connecting enterprise knowledge to AI.
  • It connects AI applications to knowledge stored across a company’s business systems.

🛠️ How it works

  • Provides 50+ enterprise connectors (Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Notion, etc.) for real‑time and scheduled indexing.
  • Enables unified search across connected systems with citations to original documents.
  • Search results are filtered by each user’s permissions (permission‑aware search).
  • Retrieves information via a graph‑backed knowledge graph that captures relationships across data.
  • Supports multimodal inputs including images, diagrams, scanned files, and voice.

⚙️ Key features

  • Explainable Answers – grounded answers with precise block citations.
  • Permission‑Aware Search – source‑level access controls.
  • Bring Your Own Model – any LLM can be run in a VPC; data never leaves the infrastructure.
  • Unified Search & Agents – search, Q&A, deep research, web search, and AI agents on one context.

🚀 Deployment

  • Install with a single command:
1

curl -fsSL https://get.pipeshub.com/install | bash

💡 Why it matters

  • Gives AI agents trusted context and teams permission‑aware search with verified citations.
  • Keeps enterprise data self‑hosted and under full control.
  • Enables developers to build agents, workflows, and MCP clients that leverage connected knowledge.

#PipesHub #EnterpriseAI #OpenSource #KnowledgeManagement #AIIntegration

Source: pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai
